messages.en:
{07 00 00}Oh, sorry, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} but 
it's too late to play
tonight.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 07 00}The dark is scary!
{07 00 00}{07 14 00}But we'll play a game of
hide-and-seek really soon!{01 01 00}
I promise, {04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Hi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}You want to
play hide-and-seek,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}{07 0e 00}Well, I don't know. It's kind
of dark{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} I don't think we'd
find much of anything.
{07 14 00}But maybe some other time!{01 00 00 05 00}
We'll try when it's bright
out, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tere, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Kas sa
tahad peitust mängida,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}{07 0e 00}Noh, ma ei tea. On üsna
pime{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma ei arva, et me
midagi leiaksime.
{07 14 00}Aga ehk mõni teine kord!{01 00 00 05 00}
Proovime, kui väljas on
valge, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}! Um, when
you have time,{07 0b 00} can we play
hide-and-seek?
{07 14 00}I really like hide-and-seek,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! Especially
the hiding part!
{07 00 00}Of course, it's way to dark
right now.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 03 00}I'd fall in a pit
or something!
{07 00 00}{07 14 00}But let's do it the next
chance we get!{01 00 00 05 00} As long as
it's sunny, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tere, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}! Ee, kui
sul on aega,{07 0b 00} kas me saame
peitust mängida?
{07 14 00}Mulle meeldib peitus väga,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! Eriti
peitmise osa!
{07 00 00}Muidugi on praegu palju
liiga pime.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 03 00}Ma kukuksin auku
või midagi!
{07 00 00}{07 14 00}Aga teeme seda esimesel
võimalusel!{01 00 00 05 00} Kui ainult on
päikseline, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
